given: an approved payroll run
when: someone wants to record that it was paid
then: deferred: paying is a movement of money (a bank file, a transfer) that is not built, so there is no paid status; adding one is a decision, not a gap to fill in passing

given: an approved payroll run
then: deferred: payroll.approved is emitted and nothing consumes it; posting payroll to the General Ledger needs an adapter and accounts that ADR 0042 does not yet define, and is its own lane

given: the social security rate and ceiling, the income tax rate and the stamp duty rate
then: the figures in deductions.ts are placeholders carried over from the first version, not approved rules; the owner and an accountant decide which rules apply, and replacing that one function is the whole of the change

given: an Organization with Properties in more than one country
then: deferred: a run is in one currency and a mixed period is refused (HR-S1-33); one run per currency would make the key (Organization, period, currency) and the screen a list of runs

given: an employee hired or terminated mid-period, or on unpaid leave
then: deferred: a run pays the full gross of everyone employed at any point in the period; pro-rating, a final payment that is less than a month and a deduction for unpaid leave are payroll rules the owner has not decided. Because an approved run is locked and there is no reversal or revision yet (HR-DEF-10), a month paid in full to someone who left on the 3rd cannot be corrected in the system until both are decided

given: a Property that is archived
when: someone edits or ends the employment of its employees
then: deferred: an archived Property is unreachable everywhere, so its employees are read and paid by whole-Organization reach but cannot be changed until they are reassigned; reassigning needs the Property reachable

given: an employee's bank details
then: deferred: nothing needs it until a payout exists (HR-DEF-01), so no path returns it; if one is added it takes its own permission and an audit record

situation: Its own permission for approving payroll
given: a role that may manage HR
then: approving takes hr.manage and whole-Organization reach, as the ticket says; whether it deserves a permission of its own, as reversing a charge got one in ADR 0041, is the owner's decision

given: a leaver with a pending leave request
when: a manager looks at the leave list
then: the request stays pending and cannot be decided, and the screen says they have left; whether it should be closed automatically is the owner's decision

given: an approved payroll run that turns out to be wrong
then: deferred: AGENTS.md says corrections use reversal or revision records and history is never deleted, and an approved run is locked against every change with no reversal or revision record built; until the owner decides what a correction to payroll is (a reversing run, a revised run, an adjustment in the next period), a wrong run can only be worked around outside the product

situation: A login linked at a Property the manager does not reach

when: they open the Employees tab and register that login
then: deferred: the employee at the other Property is not readable to them, so the login is still offered; registering it is refused by the unique index (HR-S1-51) with the already-registered message and nothing is written; telling them who holds it would need a function that reads across reach, which blueprint 3.5 does not give a Property-scoped manager
